test_send_forest: test that SendForest accepts accessibility forest protobufs and stores them in the servicer queue
test_bidi_forests_and_events: test the bidirectional Bidi gRPC stream that accepts both forest and event ClientToServer messages
test_send_forest_latest_only: test SendForest with latest_forest_only flag so only the most recent forest is retained
